changelog.change: The first plan: conversations.conversation_archived and conversations.conversation_unarchived, with a conversations.conversation snapshot (the reference flow of ADR 0020).

The conversations module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#325): 40 events for flags, streams, labels, needs, drafts and sends, taught rules and their runs, suggestions, person notes, provider batches, the model pass, Scout's reads and inboxes; records draft, need, rule and rule_run; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module.

The identity module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#326): 27 events for sign-ins succeeded and refused, accounts created, sessions ended, ways in and passkeys added and removed, suspensions, workspace and registered apps, consents, held mailbox grants, and token exchanges, reuse and revocation; records account, session, way_in, passkey, client and consent; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the module.

The web BFF instrumented (campbooks-cloud#327): 3 events for web sessions started, ended one at a time (logging out, signing in again, a copied cookie, outdated scopes, a refused refresh, unreadable tokens, an expired access token) and ended at once (back-channel logout, signing out everywhere, a suspension); the enums of how they end; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the BFF. bff is a platform module, generated into the kernel and tracked from the server.
